description: eugr's (Eugene Rakhmatulin) spark-vllm-docker qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-dflash2 recipe: NVIDIA's Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 (ModelOpt NVFP4, Apache-2.0; checkpoint revision 482ca0f3) with the z-lab Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 draft model (Apache-2.0; revision 50307d4c) for DFlash2 speculative decoding, served by vLLM on a single Spark. Runs eugr's published vllm-node image (nightly-20260929, digest pinned; its build-metadata records spark-vllm-docker 42f62e34, vLLM 0.30.1rc1.dev336+gaf5b4857e and FlashInfer 4a638133) with upstream's launch: trusted remote code, FP8 KV cache, chunked prefill, async scheduling, prefix caching, InstantTensor loading, qwen3 reasoning and qwen3_xml tool parsing, DFlash2 with 8 speculative tokens and a draft tensor-parallel size equal to the target's (the draft model is mounted as a second model), 262,144-token context, eight sequences, 4,096 batched tokens (upstream's value since 2026-10-09) and memory utilisation 0.6 (upstream's default is 0.8; see the draft-model correction below). Upstream supports both modes (tensor parallel 1 on a solo Spark, default 2 on a cluster); this is the solo mode. No upstream performance claims are recorded for this recipe. Upstream repository MIT. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint. Draft-model correction (2026-10-14): a separately loaded speculative draft model holds memory outside gpu-memory-utilization (the eugr Qwen3.8 27B DFlash2 recipe at 0.7 drove a GB10 to about 121 GB in use and froze it), so utilization is capped at 0.6 (was 0.7) and the peak budgets 0.6 x 130,663,231,488 bytes plus 8 GB plus a 17 GB draft-model allowance.
title: Qwen3.8 27B NVFP4 DFlash2 vLLM single Spark (eugr)
